name: runs tools in order and records isolated updates
input: two additive tool calls followed by a final action

name: protects caller state and stops after the first final action
input: a tool mutates its received state and a later action must not run

name: reports incomplete sessions and rejects invalid calls
input: no final action, an unknown tool, and a max-call overflow

name: nested tool arguments remain isolated and exact call budget permits final
input: a tool mutates nested arguments before final at the call limit

name: rejects malformed actions and non-mapping tool results
input: missing fields, unknown action types, boolean budget and invalid result
